# SimpleAgentWorks
> Cinematic website design and development for businesses. Our initial focus is DuPage County, Illinois; we can work with businesses outside DuPage too.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.simpleagentworks.com/): The base website offer, fit call, process and common questions.
- [DuPage cinematic website](https://www.simpleagentworks.com/dupage-cinematic.html): A second presentation of the local website offer.

## What we offer
- Cinematic business website design and development, with basic hosting included subject to agreed usage limits.
- You own and pay for your domain. Copy and images can be supplied by you or generated with your review.
- Two rounds of edits before initial launch. A basic site typically takes 3-10 business days after complete customer information and assets, subject to agreed scope.
- Custom web apps, booking flows and integrations are separate quotes. No client results or testimonials are claimed on the site.
- Google Business Profile is free; SimpleAgentWorks' paid work is website design and implementation.
- A fit call is a 30-minute Google Meet with John, bookable from the homepage.
- Contact: info@simpleagentworks.com. Address shown on site: 400 S. Hale St., Wheaton, IL 60187.
